added: packages/ecology: @sos-2/ecology — the evidence-backed COMPATIBILITY/CONFLICT GRAPH over the package population (nodes = package spine ids, never owned here — the W6 registry stays the package authority; typed edges over the frozen COMPATIBLE_WITH/CONFLICTS_WITH trace types with MANDATORY non-empty Evidence refs — an evidence-free edge assertion is REJECTED, there is no code path that adds one; symmetric relation semantics with canonical pair aggregation; coexistence reports over member sets with backing evidence surfaced per conflicting pair; spine trace-link projection with mandatory provenance; deterministic canonically-ordered queries, content-addressed record ids, snapshot/restore round trips with tamper rejection)

packages/ecology composition interaction evidence: typed SYNERGY/INTERFERENCE/NEUTRAL outcomes about the composition ITSELF — every cited evidence record's subject_ref must equal the composition id (member evidence REJECTED with a specific error: member success does not imply composition success) and truth-state consistency is enforced (SYNERGY requires a cited SUCCESS record, INTERFERENCE a cited FAILURE record); records accumulate, there is no removal API

packages/ecology decay/obsolescence signals: typed signal records over the frozen four-kind vocabulary (USAGE_DECAY, FAILURE_RATE_GROWTH, DEPENDENCY_DEPRECATION, SUPERSESSION_AGE — closed; an invented demote/retire signal kind is REJECTED) feeding a maturity REVIEW queue that NEVER auto-demotes — the queue exposes NO maturity-mutating API (demotion/retirement/supersession stay governed decisions of the W6 evidence-gated lifecycle; AGENTS.md §7 no silent autonomy), signals are Evidence-shaped input only (non-empty well-formed Evidence refs mandatory)

packages/diversity: @sos-2/diversity — the diversity ARCHIVE over the package/repertoire population as a §11-constrained MAP-Elites archive COMPOSING @sos-2/optimization's QD repertoire (MapElitesArchive/MapElitesSpec/EliteCandidate imported, never duplicated): the population is packages and compositions (spine id kinds enforced), the behavior space is the nine frozen §11 dimensions (vocabulary IMPORTED from @sos-2/packages DIVERSITY_DIMENSIONS; an axis outside §11 is REJECTED — adding a behavioral dimension is an architecture change), uncertainty carried through verbatim (§12, delegated to the W7 authority), and deterministic canonical COVERAGE REPORTS (pure function of the archive state, byte-identical across insertion orders — property-tested)

packages/diversity guards: assertPreservesFamilies REJECTS any selection that would drop every representative of a materially different HIGH-PERFORMING family (threshold caller-declared, never invented) — including the single-winner collapse; selections may only reduce the population (invented entries REJECTED); familyRepresentatives (best per family, canonical tiebreak) is the sanctioned reduction that never collapses a family; there is NO single-winner API anywhere in the package

packages/transfer: @sos-2/transfer — transfer evidence as a DISTINCT evidence class between a source context and a target context (they must differ; empty/universal contexts rejected by the W6 authority): transfer outcomes are context-conditioned and NEVER update the source package's applicability estimate — the estimate fed by a transfer must be conditioned WITHIN the target context, a source-context estimate is REJECTED at construction AND on every restore, and deriveTargetEstimate only ever returns target-conditioned estimates (declared estimate, or a derived qualitative WEAK estimate for successful transfers; failures feed no default estimate); numeric transfer probability exists ONLY as a CALIBRATED applicability estimate (calibration ref mandatory — delegated to the W6 applicability authority; no raw numeric field exists); causal claim discipline delegated to @sos-2/evidence supportsStrongCausalClaim with the claim-strength vocabulary imported from @sos-2/causal (a CAUSAL transfer claim requires interventional SUCCESS evidence; observational-only causal claims REJECTED)

packages/transfer lineage: SPECIALIZE/GENERALIZE as typed lineage operations (the frozen SPECIALIZES/GENERALIZES trace types) creating NEW package records through the W6 authority (createPackageArtifact, deterministic content-addressed identity) — STRICT context narrowing/broadening enforced (non-narrowing specializations and non-broadening generalizations REJECTED; generalization to the empty universal context REJECTED), copied-forward superset discipline (evidence refs, failure refs, learned limitations, contracts, preconditions, postconditions, realizations, assurance obligations), the base is NOT superseded (the variant joins the repertoire — diversity is intentional), derived packages always start DISCOVERED (promotion stays governed — no silent autonomy), and the lineage preserves provenance: non-empty WHO/WHAT provenance plus the operation's OWN non-empty WHICH-evidence refs plus the spine trace link; LineageStore answers derivationsOf/ancestryOf deterministically with canonical round trips

packages/transfer negative evidence retention: failed transfers are recorded exactly like successes and returned by every covering query surface (transfersFor, failedTransfersFor, transfersInto, failuresInContext — the contexts-of-failure view); INVALIDATED ASSUMPTIONS are first-class records (the falsified assumption + the context of failure retained verbatim + the invalidating evidence — evidence-free invalidation claims REJECTED); there is NO removal API on the store — retention is structural and pinned by tests that inspect the store's own surface

packages/ecology/W13.architecture-delta.json: this Architecture Delta record — DECLARED HERE because spec/** is outside W13's owned paths; validated by the spine's assertValidArchitectureDelta in packages/ecology/test/delta.test.ts; the Architect may reconcile it into spec/contracts/deltas/ at merge time
preserved_invariants: the Semantic Spine remains the ONLY identity/envelope/trace authority: all population members are referenced by their spine ids (sos://Package/..., sos://PackageComposition/..., sos://Evidence/...); the two ecology edge kinds, SPECIALIZES and GENERALIZES are frozen trace types consumed as-is; trace links are minted through createTraceLink with mandatory provenance; ecology/diversity/transfer record ids are content-addressed hashes in the W5 memory-entries pattern — NO new spine artifact kinds are registered and no second semantic/evidence/package registry is created (the W6 registry and the W3 EvidenceGraph stay the authorities)

evidence-backed assertions only (spec/architecture.md §18 'Evidence outranks assertion about system reality'; 'Packages require evidence'): an evidence-free compatibility/conflict edge is REJECTED; an evidence-free decay signal is REJECTED; an evidence-free transfer record is REJECTED; an evidence-free invalidated assumption is REJECTED; a lineage operation without its own evidence refs is REJECTED

member success does not imply composition success (docs/package-ecology.md; §18 'Compositions require their own evidence'): composition interaction evidence must be ABOUT the composition (subject_ref === composition id) — member evidence is REJECTED with a specific error; SYNERGY claims require cited SUCCESS evidence and INTERFERENCE claims cited FAILURE evidence

diversity is intentional (§11, §18; spec/architecture-lock.md forbids 'universal package winner replacing a diverse repertoire'): the §11-constrained archive preserves materially different families structurally (different behavior → different cells, never evicting each other); the diversity GUARD rejects selections collapsing high-performing families including the single-winner collapse; the sanctioned reduction is familyRepresentatives; no single-winner API exists in any of the three packages

probabilistic semantics preserved (§12; spec/meta-model.md 'Numeric confidence is valid only where calibration exists'): transfer outcomes NEVER update the source package's applicability estimate — they feed the target-context estimate only (source-conditioned estimates REJECTED at construction and on restore); numeric transfer probability exists only as a calibrated estimate with its calibration ref; uncertainty is carried through the diversity archive verbatim (delegated W7 discipline); derived qualitative estimates never invent numbers

causal evidence semantics unchanged (§18 'Intervention evidence outranks observational correlation for strong causal claims'): the strong-causal-claim rule is DELEGATED to the merged W3 authority (@sos-2/evidence supportsStrongCausalClaim) and the claim-strength vocabulary is IMPORTED from @sos-2/causal — a CAUSAL transfer claim requires interventional SUCCESS evidence and observational-only causal claims are REJECTED; nothing re-implements or redefines the rule

negative evidence and liabilities are retained (AGENTS.md §8; docs/package-ecology.md failure memory): failed transfers, invalidated assumptions and contexts-of-failure are first-class records with NO removal API; specialization/generalization copy forward failure refs and learned limitations as enforced supersets; interference records are retained like synergies

no silent autonomy (AGENTS.md §7): decay/obsolescence signals NEVER auto-demote — they feed a read-only maturity REVIEW queue with no maturity-mutating API; demotion/retirement/supersession stay governed decisions of the W6 evidence-gated lifecycle; derived packages from lineage operations always start DISCOVERED and earn maturity only through the governed promotion path

context-conditioned applicability, never universal scores (§12; docs/package-ecology.md): transfer source/target contexts are non-empty and distinct; generalization to the empty context is REJECTED; derived estimates must be consistent with the declaring context (hierarchical conditioning per docs/probabilistic-learning.md); the transfer estimate discipline is enforced at construction and re-verified on every restore

determinism and canonical round trips: every store/graph/archive query output is canonically ordered; snapshots are pure functions of the record SET (insertion-order independence property-tested with pinned seeds); all record ids are content-addressed and tampered snapshots are REJECTED; LLM output is never treated as evidence or authorization anywhere in the three packages
existing frozen contracts and the merged W0.5–W8 packages are unchanged; the change is additive within the W13 owned paths packages/ecology, packages/diversity, packages/transfer
boundary_changes: new workspace packages @sos-2/ecology (depends on @sos-2/semantic-spine, @sos-2/evidence), @sos-2/diversity (depends on @sos-2/optimization, @sos-2/packages, @sos-2/semantic-spine) and @sos-2/transfer (depends on @sos-2/causal, @sos-2/evidence, @sos-2/packages, @sos-2/semantic-spine) — all merged at the W13 base; consumption only, no modifications to any merged package, no cycles
